svg.aria-label: Wednesday United: Runs a real weekly football club: sign-ups, team sheets, payment verification and an append-only ledger. Every rule is enforced inside Postgres, with row-level security. Built with React 19, TypeScript, TanStack, Supabase, Vitest.
